requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4976-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4976-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

539-728-3249-5004.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-5004.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

465-585-1322-3742-4251.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

3240-5632-6462-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
3240-5632-6462-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-1325-5170-6132.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2842-5170-6132-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

553-1470-6108.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using High Fae Trickster.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

1116-1263-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

851-5184-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

147-1638-2060-7741.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-6798-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4871-6798-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-1497-6972.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

698-6867-6884.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-6867-6884.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 3.

49-2034-2146-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Cloud Key.
Repeat.

24-4090-5016.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Spitemare instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Spitemare triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-4090-5016.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

640-2173-4771-5220.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

132-2645-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
132-2645-4002.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-2645-4002.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

1456-3446-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

539-5147-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2105-3719-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Combat Celebrant, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Combat Celebrant or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2034-2105-3719-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

643-1486-1753-2085.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.
643-1486-1753-2085.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

579-1491-6006-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
579-1491-6006-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
579-1491-6006-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1429-4875-5402-5686.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4875-5402-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1013-1170-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}
1013-1170-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}
Cast Hypervolt Grasp by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Hypervolt Grasp spell.
Activate Hypervolt Grasp by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-3529-4231-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima's Student is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-5241.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1494-1611-1906.description:
Cast Strength of the Tajuru by paying {4}{G}{G}, targeting Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours and Feather trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Feather trigger, causing you to exile Strength of the Tajuru as it resolves.
Resolve Strength of the Tajuru, putting four +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours and exiling Strength of the Tajuru.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Feather triggers, returning Strength of the Tajuru from exile to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4050-4749-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Somberwald Beastmaster, adding {1}.
Somberwald Beastmaster dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Somberwald Beastmaster from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf, a 3/3 Beast and a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Wolf and two Beasts, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1104-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pink Horror, adding {C}{C}.
Pink Horror dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Pink Horror trigger, creating two 2/2 Blue Horror creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Blue Horror, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, paying {4} to return Pink Horror from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Blue Horror tokens, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell to deal infinite damage to any number of targets.

851-2367-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.

1987-2427-2493.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2427-2493.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
